membersPage.title: Members
membersPage.description: Invite people and manage what each can do.

apiKeysPage.title: API keys

apiKeysPage.adminOnly: Only owners and admins can manage API keys.

columnsPage.title: Lead columns

general.title: Organization
general.nameAndSlugRequired: A name and a URL name are required.
general.slugTaken: That URL name is already taken. Try another.
general.ownersOnly: Only owners and admins can change these details.
general.footer: Everyone in an organization sees the same leads, campaigns and conversations.
general.leaveHint: You can be invited back at any time.
general.leaveConfirmDescription: You will lose access to its leads, campaigns and conversations until someone invites you again.

members.inviteDescription: They get an email with a link to join this organization.
members.pendingDescription: Where no email service is set up, copy the link and send it yourself.
members.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link manually: /accept-invitation/{id}

teams.note: Teams group people; everyone in the organization sees the same data.
teams.noMembers: No one is on this team yet.
teams.deleteDescription: People stay in the organization; only the team is removed.

apiKeys.revokeDescription: Anything using this key stops working at once. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.
apiKeys.intro: A key acts for the whole organization, limited to what you tick when you create it. Send it as {header} to /api/v1/, or use it to connect an AI assistant to /api/mcp without signing in (Settings → AI assistants).
apiKeys.createdBody: It is shown only once. Store it in the other application's settings.
apiKeys.createDescription: Name it after what will use it, for example the app's name.

crmRead.label: Read the CRM
crmRead.description: See the Action required queue and lead records: conversations, details and calls.

crmWrite.label: Work the CRM
crmWrite.description: Edit and rewrite drafts, change stages, snooze or close records, and mark leads Do Not Contact.

crmSend.label: Send messages
crmSend.description: Send replies to leads by email, LinkedIn or WhatsApp as you.

campaignsWrite.label: Manage campaign leads
campaignsWrite.description: Add leads to email campaigns and stop their sequences.
